content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Ten per cent of the vacancies are reserved for Ex-Servicemen in the respective post and category. The vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess either of the following qualifications: Degree from a recognised university or equivalent with Psychology as a subject; or Degree from a recognised university along with Bachelor of Education or Bachelor of Teaching, or an equivalent qualification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is relaxable for ST, OBC and Ex-Servicemen candidates according to applicable government rules.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Salary
content_sections.text: The Head Constable (Education and Stress Counsellor) post carries Pay Level 4 with a salary of Rs.25,500-81,100 under the 7th Central Pay Commission. The appointment will initially be temporary but is likely to become permanent in ITBP. Selected candidates may be required to serve anywhere in India or abroad.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The ITBP Head Constable selection process will consist of: Physical Efficiency Test Physical Standard Test Written Examination Verification of Original Documents Detailed Medical Examination Review Medical Examination, where applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ITBP Head Constable Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the ITBP recruitment portal at recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in . Open the recruitment link for Head Constable (Education and Stress Counsellor) 2026. Complete the online registration using a valid email address and mobile number. Enter the required personal, educational and category details. Upload the photograph, signature and required certificates. Pay the application fee, if applicable. Review the entered information and submit the application. Download or print the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications will be accepted only through the ITBP online recruitment portal. No offline application will be accepted. Candidates should provide a functional email address and mobile number. Admit cards will be issued online to candidates whose applications are accepted. Applicants must check the detailed notification before submitting their forms. Candidates should regularly visit the ITBP recruitment website for subsequent updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ITBP Head Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ITBP has announced 16 Head Constable (Education and Stress Counsellor) vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for male candidates?
faq.answer: Fourteen vacancies are available for male candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for female candidates?
faq.answer: Two vacancies are available for female candidates.

faq.question: Q4. When will the online application process begin?
faq.answer: The online application process will begin on 28 September 2026 at 12:01 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 27 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the ITBP Head Constable post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 20 and 25 years as of 27 October 2026, subject to applicable relaxation.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a recognised degree with Psychology as a subject, or a recognised degree with B.Ed, Bachelor of Teaching or an equivalent qualification.
